_comment: Copy this file to app.config.json and fill in all values. This is the ONLY config/secrets file — no .env needed.

integrations._comment: Only the four supported CRM integrations are configured here: website, Instagram, Meta Ads/CAPI, and OnlinePBX.

instagram._comment: Create a Meta Business app with Instagram API with Instagram Login. Add the OAuth redirect and webhook callback shown on the CRM Integrations page.

metaAds._comment: Used for ad attribution, Instant Form lead retrieval and CRM events via Meta Conversions API. Keep tokens and webhook secrets only in app.config.json. accessToken remains a backwards-compatible fallback for marketing/CAPI only.

onlinePbx._comment: Domain is the PBX hostname, for example pbx12345.onpbx.ru. Keep authKey and webhookSecret only in app.config.json and never commit them.
